test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: For Assembly elections (February - March 2022) in Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand and Punjab, the expenditure limit for legislative assembly candidates was revised to ₹ ______ lakh in January 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**40**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **For Assembly elections (February - March 2022) in Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand and Punjab**, the expenditure limit for legislative assembly candidates was revised to **₹40 lakh in January 2022.** 
 
• According to a notification from the Law Ministry, **the increased value of Rs. 40 lakh** would be applicable in **Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and Punjab and Rs. 28 lakh in Goa and Manipur.**
 
• **The most recent significant change to candidate spending caps was made in 2014, with the exception of a 10% increase in response to the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020.**
 
• In 2020, the EC established a committee to investigate the spending cap.
 
• Political parties, key election officials, and election observers were invited to provide comments by the committee.
 
• The committee discovered a significant rise in the number of voters and the Cost Inflation Index during 2014.
 
• It also had a role in the evolving campaigning strategies, which eventually moved toward virtual campaigns.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• In order to elect all 403 members of the **18th Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly**, elections for the assembly were held in seven phases from** 10 February to 7 March 2022.**
 
• In order to choose the 70 members of the **Uttarakhand Legislative Assembly**, **elections were held on February 14, 2022.**
 
• **Punjab** held its legislative assembly elections on **February 20, 2022, to choose the 117 members of the province's 16th assembly. **
